template.description: The handlebars template resulting in a command.

resultParser.description: The parser able to convert the raw results of this instrument.

timeAllocated.description: The amount of time (in ms) allocated for the execution of this controller.

extension.description: Possible extension in case of a scriptable instrument.

subjectIsLocal.description: Is the subject for this instrument local or remote?

arguments.description: A string representation of the arguments object.

code.description: A code representing the "goodness" of the result, 0 being "good", 2 being "bad".

interpretation.description: A short word conveying the meaning of "stateCode", e.g. "OK", "MAYBE", "NOK"

description.description: A longer description of the reason for the status code.
